task_description: Replace the Grok auth-broker federation with REAL self-hosted Better Auth (email+password + optional Google) that works on built-helion.vercel.app with no broker or unobtainable credentials; keep auth OPTIONAL and NON-BLOCKING (sim + feedback fully usable logged out). Build the outstanding PUBLIC votable feedback board inside the sim with no PII exposed, fix the email-optional submit bug, and add a Settings page with an 'auto-fill my email on feedback' toggle that defaults OFF and only pre-fills when ON + logged in. No mock/seed data anywhere; all data is real Postgres.
